DitherBarChart.categories: The label of every bar, or group of bars.
DitherBarChart.series: The bars, each { label, color, values, low, high, dashed }.
DitherBarChart.stack: none: the series sit side by side. stacked: on top of each other. percent: stacked and scaled to 100%.
DitherBarChart.highlight: The bar drawn solid while nothing is hovered: last, max or none.
DitherBarChart.highlight-at: The index of the bar to highlight. Overrides highlight when it is 0 or more.
DitherBarChart.level: Gradient only: coverage at the top of each bar, 0 to 1.
DitherBarChart.axes: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherBarChart.tooltip: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherBarChart.interactive: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherBarChart.animated: The bars are drawn in from the left when the chart appears.
DitherBarChart.unit: Written after every value. Values are shortened to 1.2K.
DitherBarChart.chart-height: Height of the chart, axes included.
